clauses.clause: When this creature enters, ... this creature deals 2 damage to each opponent.
clauses.evidence: [cast] and the flash-in stimulus: the trigger fires and the opponent takes 2 (20 -> 18); nobody else is hurt.

clauses.clause: ... if you control another creature with power 4 or greater, ...
clauses.evidence: you_giant (4/4, power exactly 4) is on every standard board, so the condition is true in every trace; its false branch is never seen. Packs: K07_1 (false: my 3/3, their 5/5, the Ogre's own power 4), K07_3 and K07_4 (checked again as the trigger resolves), K07_2 (each opponent in a three-player game), K07_5 (current power: a 3/3 with a +1/+1 counter qualifies).
